story.fullStory:
Luke's "Raise The Roof" reached #26 on the Billboard Hot 100. American country music singer and songwriter Luke Combs has released six studio albums, four extended plays, and twenty singles.

American country music singer and songwriter Luke Combs has released six studio albums, four extended plays, and twenty singles.
Of his twenty singles, sixteen have gone to number one on the Billboard Country Airplay chart.
He made his debut in 2016 with the song "Hurricane", the first of three singles from his debut album This One's for You.
Luke James Steele (born 13 December 1979) is a New Zealand–born Australian musician, singer and songwriter.
Steele is the vocalist and primary songwriter of the alternative rock band the Sleepy Jackson and is a member of the electronic music duo Empire of the Sun.

Steele was born in Auckland, New Zealand, on 13 December 1979.

American country music singer and songwriter Luke Combs has released six studio albums, four extended plays, and twenty singles.

"Beautiful Crazy" is also Combs's highest-certified single, with a diamond certification from the Recording Industry Association of America (RIAA) for sales of ten million.

In March 2001, on the eve of the band's deal with EMI Records, the band toured with Magic Dirt and Motor Ace, adding Ronan Charles on keyboard.

In 2001, EMI released Caffeine in the Morning Sun, which Steele recorded in Sydney with session musicians.
